title: BNCI2003_IVa Motor Imagery dataset
description: The BNCI2003_IVa Motor Imagery dataset comprises EEG recordings from 5 healthy subjects performing motor imagery tasks (right hand and feet movements) in response to visual cues. This preprocessed dataset contains 280 trials per subject acquired at 100 Hz using 118 EEG channels and represents one of the earliest and most influential motor imagery BCI datasets from BCI Competition III. The data has been extensively used for benchmarking brain-computer interface classification algorithms and feature extraction methods.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a BrainAmp system with 118 channels at 1000 Hz sampling rate, then band-pass filtered (0.05-200 Hz) and downsampled to 100 Hz for offline analysis. Subjects performed motor imagery tasks (right hand or feet) for 3.5 seconds following visual cues presented at random intervals (1.75-2.25 s). The dataset includes 280 trials per subject split into labeled training and unlabeled test sets.
